claim: Agent claims about code must carry code: anchors that resolve at read time; an unresolvable anchor is an ungrounded claim and must be fixed or withdrawn before the claim is presented.

evidence.detail: The prescriptive extraction of the position's conditional (b485), anchored to the resolver's enforcement site - the anchor-not-found warning constructor in lib/cb/codepath.ex; anchor verified resolving with exactly one match at authoring time. Recurring rule: fires on every agent answer that cites code; non-contract grade until a draft-mode verifier exists to machine-check compliance.

The stated escalation condition is met: b512 discharged 2026-06-11 - mix cb.resolve --file machine-checks code: anchors with no belief collection loaded, so draft-mode compliance verification exists. Escalation to contract grade is now unblocked but remains a deliberate act (a contract needs rules per b056), not an automatic consequence of the tool landing.
